The algorithm team is responsible for developing state\-of\-the\-art computer vision, NLP and multimodality models and algorithms to protect our platform and users from the content and behaviors that violate community guidelines and related regulations. With the continuous efforts from our team, TikTok is able to provide the best user experience and bring joy to everyone in the world.

* Leverage multimodal large models to explore few\-shot and zero\-shot strategies for content safety scenarios, and build moderation models with strong generalization capabilities.
* Participate in reinforcement learning–based data mining, and help design Chain\-of\-Thought (CoT) annotation frameworks to improve the model’s understanding of complex risks.
* Build risk ranking and recall systems to enhance coverage and accuracy in identifying high\-risk content.
* Collaborate with product and policy teams to drive real\-world deployment and performance optimization of moderation algorithms.


Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Currently pursuing a Master degree with a background in computer science, machine learning, or similar fields;
* Solid foundation in machine learning and deep learning; familiarity with multimodal modeling; hands\-on experience with large model projects is a plus.
* Interest in content safety, with an understanding of the challenges in risk identification within moderation workflows.
* Proficient in end\-to\-end algorithm development, including data processing, modeling, and evaluation; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow is required.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Strong learning ability, clear communication, and a strong sense of teamwork and responsibility.

Responsibilities
  
  

About the Team
  
Our team builds a global copyright protection platform that translates legal requirements, business policies, and operational workflows into reliable and scalable systems. The platform supports complaint intake, regional routing, human review, enforcement, notifications, creator appeals, rightsholder rebuttals, and proactive content identification.
  
  

You will work on complex event\-driven systems and multi\-region distributed architectures, addressing real\-world challenges in consistency, idempotency, cross\-region routing, reliability, and compliance.
  
  

What We Offer
  
* Direct involvement in the design and development of TikTok's global copyright protection core systems, with business impact reaching hundreds of millions of users worldwide.
* Hands\-on experience with Go microservices architecture, event\-driven architecture, and multi\-data\-center distributed systems.
* Comprehensive mentorship program (1:1 Mentor) with a clear growth path — full\-cycle participation from requirement analysis to production deployment.
* A collaborative, cross\-functional environment working with product, algorithm, and front\-end teams, enabling rapid cross\-domain learning.
* Competitive compensation and benefits; outstanding interns/new grads will receive full\-time conversion opportunities.


We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands\-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real\-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
  
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
  
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Participate in the architecture design and development of core backend services for the copyright protection platform, writing high\-quality Go code across modules including complaint intake, audit scheduling, enforcement execution, and appeal management.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of event\-driven architecture, building high\-availability event flow pipelines based on EventBus/MQ that ensure reliable delivery and eventual consistency across cross\-service business workflows.
* Design, optimize, and maintain databases (MySQL/NoSQL) supporting efficient storage and querying at billion\-scale data volumes, ensuring data integrity and consistency.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and RPC interfaces, ensuring efficient and secure data exchange between front\-end applications, internal platforms, and external systems.
* Participate in system design and data synchronization strategies for multi\-DC (Multi\-Data Center / Multi\-VGeo) architecture, solving distributed challenges such as cross\-region replication lag and read\-after\-write consistency.
* Monitor and optimize system performance, identify and resolve potential bottlenecks, and improve system throughput and response speed.
* Quickly respond to and resolve production environment issues, ensuring system stability and business continuity.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, front\-end engineers, algorithm teams, and other stakeholders to ensure high\-quality and on\-time project delivery.


Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master degree in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Able to commit to working for 12 weeks during the Summer of 2027\.
* Proficient in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, or C\+\+; Go experience is a plus.
* Familiar with common database technologies such as MySQL, Redis, and MongoDB; understanding of index optimization and basic performance tuning.
* Understanding of RESTful API design and development; familiarity with RPC frameworks (e.g., Thrift, gRPC) is a plus; familiar with Linux\-based operating systems and common commands; basic Shell scripting ability.
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking abilities, passion for new technologies, and a quick learning ability.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a strong team\-oriented mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Understanding of microservices architecture and related technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, etc.
* Experience in developing large\-scale distributed systems; understanding of message queues (e.g., Kafka, EventBus), distributed transactions, and eventual consistency.

Responsibilities
  
  

The Signal \& Measurement team at TikTok Ads is responsible for the full stack of advertising effectiveness — from signal collection and identity resolution to attribution modeling and causal measurement. We build the systems and models that help advertisers worldwide understand and maximize the true business value of their ad spend on TikTok.
  
Our work sits at the intersection of distributed systems and causal inference. We operate at massive scale while applying rigorous statistical methodology to answer the hardest question in advertising: "Did this ad actually work?"
  
  

We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.

* Help build large\-scale experimentation infrastructure and real\-time data pipelines powering Conversion Lift, Brand Lift, Split Test, and cross\-media measurement products.
* Explore LLM\-powered signal intelligence — leverage large language models for semantic understanding of advertiser conversion data, enabling intelligent classification, quality assessment, and automated correction of event signals.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Infrastructure teams to translate algorithmic ideas into production systems serving advertisers globally.

jobs.description:
We are looking for talented machine learning engineers who are excited to tackle some of the most meaningful and technically challenging problems in building and deploying foundation model\-based products for our customers.  

  

As a Machine Learning Engineer focused on foundation model evaluation, you will play a critical role in assessing the capabilities of the models that power Apple Intelligence features.  

  

You will work closely with machine learning researchers to translate evaluation insights into actionable improvements that advance future model performance.  

  

**Description**  

  

As a foundation model evaluation Machine Learning Engineer, you will be entrusted with ensuring that foundation model performance can be measured quickly and reliably, in order to support crucial model shipping decisions.  

  

You will design, implement, and maintain crucial evaluation infrastructure.  

  

You will collaborate extensively with ML researchers on both model hillclimbing and developing novel methodologies for measuring model performance.  

  

Your responsibilities will span a number of high\-impact parts of the Apple product and foundation model lifecycle.  

  

","responsibilities":"Ensure the stability, reliability, and performance of Apple's foundation model evaluation system.  

  

Design and implement novel evaluation methodologies.  

  

Help design and implement tooling to simplify metrics generation, ingestion, and reporting.  

  

Leverage agentic LLM systems to facilitate and improve model evaluations.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Hands on experience with evaluating large language models at scale or designing large language model benchmarks.  

  

Strong communication skills, able to clearly and concisely convey important information.  

  

Self\-motivated and curious. Strive to continually learn on the job.  

  

High level of creative and critical thinking skills with an innate drive to improve how things work. Have a high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to identify the most important problems to solve.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

5\+ years of hands on ML engineering experiences, with at least 1\+ years working directly on large language models or generative AI.  

  

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field \- or equivalent practical experience.  

  

Strong software engineering fundamentals: debugging, testing, code reviews, and production reliability / scalability.  

  

Hands\-on experience with LLM training and / or evaluation workflows, including any of the following: pre\-training, post\-training, online evaluation, offline evaluation, automated evaluation, human evaluation.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: AIML - Data Scientist, Evaluation
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly.  

  

Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

  

The AIML Evaluation org works with teams across Apple to build platforms, create methodologies, and enable partners to measure, understand, and proactively improve their products.  

  

We are looking for an outstanding candidate to become a member of the Evaluation team to help own and drive part of our technical portfolio for Apple Intelligence. Our work ensures that Apple systems maintain the highest standards for data quality and user privacy compliance.  

  

**Description**  

  

As a Data Scientist on the AIML Evaluation team, you will play a key role in ensuring data quality and privacy compliance across some of Apple's most impactful products.  

  

You will contribute to building and maintaining monitoring systems, dashboards, and automated processes that help teams understand and uphold Apple's rigorous privacy standards.  

  

This role blends analytical thinking with practical engineering skills in a highly collaborative environment.  

  

","responsibilities":"Partner with product, engineering, and data science teams to support compliance\-aware feature development \- consulting on new feature design, flagging privacy considerations, and identifying monitoring requirements early in the product lifecycle.  

  

Build and maintain automated data pipelines, compliance checks, and dashboards that provide clear visibility into data quality and policy adherence over time.  

  

Investigate and triage data quality and compliance issues, help quantify their impact, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.  

  

Perform ad hoc analyses to support ongoing compliance work to inform decision\-making across the team.  

  

Successful candidates will have a genuine passion for user privacy and strong communication skills. You should be comfortable operating in a cross\-functional environment with some ambiguity, and be eager to grow your technical skills alongside experienced teammates.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Prior involvement in data collection design with privacy or regulatory considerations in mind.  

  

Familiarity with data governance, compliance monitoring, or privacy\-preserving data practices.  

  

Comfort working across cross\-functional teams with multiple stakeholders.  

  

Proven ability to build or contribute to dashboards and data visualizations for both technical and non\-technical audiences.  

  

Exposure to logging frameworks or analytic instrumentation design.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\+ years of industry experience in Data Science, Data Engineering, or Data Analytics.  

  

Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with hands\-on experience in data processing, analysis, and pipeline development.  

  

Demonstrated commitment to user privacy and a working understanding of data privacy principles.  

  

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings for a broad audience.  

  

Bachelor's or Master's in a technical or quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

About the Team
  
**The Agentic Ops US team focuses on two major areas:** Code Graph and Quality Validation. The code graph serves as the data foundation for validation, encompassing static relationships (function calls, experiment/instrumentation dependencies) and dynamic execution paths (reconstructed from traces). Quality validation covers static rule checking (mining soft and logical constraints) and dynamic issue detection, reproduction, and fixing. We aim to improve code reliability and R\&D efficiency through systematic, data\-driven approaches.
  
  

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands\-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real\-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

1\. Participate in building and optimizing the code graph, including static relationship extraction, dynamic trace data cleansing, and aggregation.
  
2\. Develop static validation rules (logical and soft constraints) based on the graph, and contribute to the design and implementation of dynamic validation tools (issue reproduction, root cause localization).
  
3\. Conduct in\-depth analysis of production quality issues, distill general validation patterns, and drive automation coverage.
  
4\. Research and introduce cutting\-edge academic and industrial techniques in code analysis, program slicing, anomaly detection, etc., to continuously improve validation effectiveness.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**


We're a small, ambitious team at the intersection of private market investing and artificial intelligence. This is an early\- to mid\-career software engineering role focused on building **applied AI systems at the application layer** — shipping agent\-powered features, full\-stack apps, and durable workflows that power real, economically valuable work.


You'll take meaningful ownership of production systems that translate rapidly improving model capabilities into dependable tools, while helping shape the technical foundation and culture of a tight\-knit engineering team. You'll receive direct user feedback and lead substantial projects across product, agents, data, and infrastructure.

**This role is on\-site in San Francisco, CA.** Candidates must be based there or willing to relocate. **No visa sponsorship is available** — applicants must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

### **What You'll Do**

* Build production systems spanning agent architectures, full\-stack applications, durable workflows, and data infrastructure.
* Own system design, deployment, and iteration for agent\-powered features end to end.
* Evaluate new models, frameworks, tool\-use patterns, and context strategies — then productionize the improvements that matter.
* Build evaluation pipelines, observability tooling, and human\-review systems that make agent behavior measurable and reliable.
* Develop durable workflows and data infrastructure handling tool coordination, state management, retries, and failure recovery.
* Design and implement interfaces that make complex agent workflows clear, fast, and intuitive for end users.
* Lead substantial projects across product, agents, data, and infrastructure with direct exposure to user feedback.
* Help shape the engineering culture and technical direction of a small, high\-ownership team.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* A few years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals and a demonstrated track record of shipping production systems.
* Experience building full\-stack applications and owning features end to end.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, AI agents, tool use, evaluations, or related applied AI systems.
* Experience designing and delivering production\-grade software for AI agents — from concept through deployment.
* Familiarity with building and maintaining durable workflows, stateful coordination, retries, and failure recovery for tool integrations.
* Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and reliability practices for AI systems (e.g., metrics, tracing, dashboards).
* Ability to design user\-facing interfaces for complex agent workflows and iterate based on user feedback.
* High agency, strong product judgment, and comfort moving across product, backend, data, and infrastructure.
* Genuine curiosity about agent developments with the judgment to separate meaningful advances from hype.
* Comfort operating in a small team environment with broad problem scope and incomplete specs.

**Nice to Have:**

* Background in fintech, financial data, or capital markets.
* Experience at early\-stage startups.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems.
* Experience building human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience handling sensitive or permissioned data.

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Salary:** $150,000 – $250,000 annually, depending on experience.
* Equity participation in a small, high\-conviction team.
* Close collaboration with a tight\-knit team on high\-impact, production AI systems.

### **Location**


This is a **full\-time, on\-site role in San Francisco, CA**. Candidates must be based in San Francisco or genuinely willing to relocate. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this position.

**Visa sponsorship is not available.** Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship, now or in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**


A fast\-growing, Y Combinator–backed AI startup in the supply chain space is looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer** to join their small, high\-velocity engineering team in San Francisco. You'll build the backbone of an AI\-powered platform that plans and executes how consumer goods are produced and moved globally — turning the messy, physical flow of goods into programmable, reliable, scalable systems.


This is an end\-to\-end ownership role at a seed\-stage company (fewer than 10 people) operating at the intersection of AI, logistics, and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG). You'll have a direct and meaningful impact on the core product from day one.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and implement backend systems that power AI\-driven supply chain decisions and automated execution.
* Architect data models and pipelines to ingest, clean, and organize messy, real\-world supply chain data.
* Ensure user requests and supply chain plans are processed in real time for reliable, 24/7 operation.
* Build scalable, high\-performance SQL queries and data access patterns across large datasets.
* Ship production\-grade services using modern backend frameworks and rigorous testing practices.
* Collaborate closely with the core product and engineering team to translate logistics workflows into software.
* Own and continuously improve deployment pipelines and runbook processes to keep systems running reliably.
* Leverage AI code generation and management tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) to accelerate development, including parallelizing service instances for continuous operation.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must\-haves (dealbreakers):**

* **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience as a Backend Engineer with a strong track record of designing data architectures and shipping real products.
* Proficiency in **Python** and modern backend frameworks such as **FastAPI**, with testing tools like **pytest**.
* Demonstrated proficiency with **AI\-assisted coding tools** (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode), including experience parallelizing instances for autonomous, 24/7 operation.

**Required skills:**

* Experience organizing and managing messy, real\-world data at scale.
* Strong SQL skills — writing high\-performance queries over millions of data points.
* Solid system design skills; comfortable designing scalable data architectures with minimal supervision.
* Experience owning backend systems end\-to\-end, including real\-time request processing.
* Experience with large\-scale data architectures and systems engineering.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience building unstructured data ingestion systems.
* Experience with frontend frameworks and their testing tools.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and **AWS**.
* Background or genuine interest in supply chain, logistics, or CPG industries.

### **Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Salary:** $110,000 – $200,000 USD annually, depending on experience.
* Early\-stage equity in a well\-funded, high\-growth startup.
* **Visa sponsorship available.**

### **Location**


This is an **on\-site role based in San Francisco, CA**. You'll work alongside a tight\-knit, fast\-moving team in person. Remote arrangements are not available for this position.

Product(Captions by Mirage)

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in shaping the future of Advertising and B2B Sales? We are a growing science and engineering team with an exciting charter and need your passion, innovative thinking, and creativity to help take our products to new heights.  

  

Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our businesses driving long term growth. We break fresh ground in product and technical innovations every day!  

  

Within the Advertising Sales organization, we are building a central AI/ML team and are seeking top science talent to build new, science\-backed services to drive success for our customers. Our goal is to transform the way account teams operate by creating actionable insights and recommendations they can share with their advertising accounts, and ingesting Generative AI throughout their end\-to\-end workflows to improve their work efficiency.  

  

As a part of our team, you will bring deep expertise in quantitative modeling (statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, and causal inference) to build and refine models that inform how account teams operate. You will apply generative AI within our ad sales support technologies, and you have the communication skills necessary to explain complex technical approaches to a variety of stakeholders and customers. You will be part of a team of fellow scientists and engineers taking on iterative approaches to tackle big, long\-term problems.  

  

Why you will love this opportunity: Amazon has invested heavily in building a world\-class advertising business. This team defines and delivers a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our solutions generate billions in revenue and drive long\-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses. We deliver billions of ads impressions, millions of clicks daily, and break fresh ground to create world\-class products. We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun\-loving team with an entrepreneurial spirit with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate.  

  

Impact and Career Growth: You will invent new experiences and influence customer\-facing shopping experiences; this is your opportunity to work within the fastest growing businesses across all of Amazon! Turn customer needs into data science problems and actionable recommendations for your product, engineering, and sales partners. This role combines analytical rigor, technical strength, product focus, and business understanding.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Build and apply LLM\-based solutions (retrieval\-augmented generation, prompting, and agentic workflows) to solve Ad Sales problems and generate seller\-facing insights and recommendations.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into data science problems, and build the statistical and machine learning models that complement LLM workflows, such as ranking, retrieval evaluation, segmentation, and forecasting.

* Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, and mentor junior data scientists on your team.

  

About the team  

Sales AI is a central science and engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales that powers selling motions and account team workflows via state\-of\-the\-art of AI/ML services. Sales AI is investing in a range of sales intelligence models, including the development of advertiser insights, recommendations and Generative AI\-powered applications throughout account team workflows.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2\+ years of data scientist experience
* 3\+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
* 3\+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
* 1\+ years of guiding and coaching a group of researchers experience
* 1\+ years of working with or evaluating AI systems experience
* 1\+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience
* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

* Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
* Experience working on multi\-team, cross\-disciplinary projects

About the Team
  
**The Agentic Ops US team focuses on two major areas:** Code Graph and Quality Validation. The code graph serves as the data foundation for validation, encompassing static relationships (function calls, experiment/instrumentation dependencies) and dynamic execution paths (reconstructed from traces). Quality validation covers static rule checking (mining soft and logical constraints) and dynamic issue detection, reproduction, and fixing. We aim to improve code reliability and R\&D efficiency through systematic, data\-driven approaches.
  
  

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands\-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real\-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Responsibilities
  
1\. Participate in building and optimizing the code graph, including static relationship extraction, dynamic trace data cleansing, and aggregation.
  
2\. Develop static validation rules (logical and soft constraints) based on the graph, and contribute to the design and implementation of dynamic validation tools (issue reproduction, root cause localization).
  
3\. Conduct in\-depth analysis of production quality issues, distill general validation patterns, and drive automation coverage.
  
4\. Research and introduce cutting\-edge academic and industrial techniques in code analysis, program slicing, anomaly detection, etc., to continuously improve validation effectiveness.
